title: manulea viscosa
intro: Manulea viscosa, commonly known as sticky manulea, is a plant species found in the Western Cape Province of South Africa. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Manulea viscosa include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Manulea viscosa include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
